title: Texas Roadhouse, Inc. Appoints Lisa Ingram to Board of Directors
summary: LOUISVILLE, Ky., March 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Texas Roadhouse, Inc. (Nasdaq: TXRH) announced today that Lisa Ingram has been appointed to the Company’s Board of Directors. Ms. Ingram is the Chief Executive Officer and Chair of the Board of Directors for White Castle System, Inc., which is based in Columbus, Ohio. White Castle currently has 340 restaurants in 14 states. In addition, the company owns and operates 6 manufacturing plants that supply products to its restaurants and its consumer product goods, which are sold in grocery stores in all 50 states. Known as the “Slider Queen,” Ingram has led White Castle since 2015 and is the fourth-generation family member to lead the iconic 105-year-old brand, which is considered to be the nation’s first fast-food hamburger chain. Jerry Morgan, Texas Roadhouse Chief Executive Officer and Executive Vice Chairman of the Board commented, “We are excited to have Lisa join our Board of Directors.
